name: Dijkstra's Shortest Path
description: Dijkstra's algorithm finds the shortest path between nodes in a weighted graph. It uses a greedy approach, always selecting the unvisited node with the smallest known distance. The algorithm maintains a set of visited nodes and updates distances to neighboring nodes, guaranteeing the shortest path in graphs with non-negative edge weights.

aiExplanation.content: Dijkstra's algorithm is a greedy algorithm that finds the shortest path from a source node to all other nodes in a weighted graph with non-negative edges. It maintains a priority queue of nodes to visit, always selecting the node with the smallest known distance. As it visits each node, it updates the distances to its neighbors if a shorter path is found. The algorithm guarantees optimal shortest paths and is widely used in GPS navigation, network routing, and game pathfinding.
